incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in flames, with fire burning through the roof and visible from the front porch and windows.

observations.description: Large, intense orange flames consuming the roof and interior of the house.
Smoke rising from the burning roof and upper levels of the house.
Roof is partially collapsed and charred; porch and walls showing fire damage.
Single-story house with siding, porch, and windows.
Trees visible in the background behind the house.
Debris and fallen siding on the ground near the house.
